FullDescription: This award-winning collection of contemporary rugs discovers beauty in errors. Project Error is a study of misprints and nature’s interruption of mechanical duplication to create unique pieces of art. Drawing inspiration from the crossroads of nature and machines, works of art emerge as new, spontaneous, and unique designs. If modern abstract designs are your thing, our Project Error rugs will surely be a great fit for your spaces.

Kavi noticed patterns created by a candle reflected on glass and spent time observing these patterns that emerged through a prism. The constantly evolving forms were recreated using organic dyes and batik printing on mediums formerly unused. Designs thus created were transferred onto rugs through hand-knotting, carefully selected, and dyed yarns.

The Hula collection is inspired by the sinuous movement of hula dance. Made using the finest quality of jute and hemp, this collection will take you closer to mother Earth. These highly textured handmade rugs elevate the concept of green floor covering to a new level of sophistication. Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, and outdoor spaces, the hula collection is set up to spruce up your floors.

Inspired by primitive art and designs from cultures all over the world, the Erbe collection is knotted meticulously by hand to create masterpieces. Featuring timeless Persian motifs and Oriental patterns woven using high-quality wool yarns by the most skilled artisans, our rugs from the Erbe collections are sure to impress and become heirlooms to be passed on.

With hints of skill and time, the Savana Collection is a tapestry of tradition. Oriental elegance blends with lush, tropical dreams, and the bold geometry of Art Deco plays with the spirit of Moroccan traditions in each rug's narrative. These pieces, which are hand-knotted from the finest wool, are classic works of craftsmanship that go beyond simple floor coverings. The collection offers a range of options, perfectly complementing both minimalist and eclectic styles in living rooms and bedrooms.

A painting of the cosmos, the Genesis collection is an interpretation of what our worlds would look like before they couldn’t even be seen. The collection showcases pastel colors and vague shapes coexist with the hopes of blending into a concrete idea. Made from the finest quality wool and viscose, each rug is precisely hand-tufted by experienced artisans. Designed with resilience against everyday wear and tear, the collection is perfect for any room in your house.

The Gauri Khan collection for Jaipur Rugs brings untold stories of rustic charm to modern spaces. Created to reflect the multitude of traditions, shapes, and colors found throughout rural India, this exquisite line of rugs blurs the barriers between urban luxury and the charming simplicity of village life. Jazz up your living spaces with this artistic line of handmade rugs.

The Hidden collection is inspired by the unnoticed beauty of experiences and processes while undergoing development and is still in motion. The mystery of not knowing the outcome and result is what dominates every pattern and artful representation of this collection. Made from fine quality wool and bamboo silk, each design depicts the chaotic element of a journey, expressed through a palette of grays, blues, whites, and mahogany, sometimes infused with occasional twirls, otherwise embraced in their basic form.

Explore modern designs for a contemporary space with the opulent Uvenuti collection. A collection of mesh textures and abstract designs, Uvenuti weaves a calm atmosphere with on-trend blues, saturated grays, and earth hues of white. Knotted to perfection, by hand, using high-quality premium yarns, it is a work of art for your floors, perfect for an artistic look in your living room or professional spaces.

From the first shear of the wool to the final finishing of the rug, rug-making itself is storytelling. Discover Unstring - a rendition of these storytelling voices in motion, where the designers and weavers let go of all ties to tie knots. This collection captures an artist's interaction with all the elements involved in the design. Shop this collection of hand-knotted rugs made using the best quality yarns and adorn your floors with these pieces of art.

Enhance your home with magnificent antique rugs exclusively from the Far East collection. Featuring traditional patterns that invoke an aura of spectacular opulence and majestic shades works beautifully with every type of decor. This hand-knotted collection is made from the finest quality of wool and silk to deliver a marvelous silken feel with dense, luxurious texture.

Our rugs from the Basis collection are proof that simplicity, elegance, and lucidity, is a statement in itself. With bold colors and an uneven and faded look, these rugs are designed to make the perfect first impression and then maintain that. These lightly-distressed rugs in neutral tones are made out of the most premium blends of yarns and woven on hand-looms by our master artisans and are sure to be a subtle yet fashionable choice for your home decor.

Manifest is a line of hand-knotted carpets with an all-wool construction of Afghan heritage that interprets the well-known Moroccan designs into an aesthetically modern sensibility. The eclectic patterns knotted on these exquisitely colored rugs occupy as much place in a traditional home as they do in a garden. A perfect example of what natural designs can be turned into, Manifest is sure to take the decor of your living room space or bedroom a notch higher.
